title: Best Damn RSS to JSON Converter input
description: Paste feed URLs or website URLs. Every delivered feed item is one billable result; feeds that cannot be found, fetched or parsed are reported for free.

feedUrls.title: Feed or website URLs
feedUrls.description: One URL per line. RSS 2.0, Atom, RSS 1.0 (RDF) and JSON Feed URLs are parsed directly. If a URL is an ordinary web page, the Actor looks for the feed it advertises (`<link rel="alternate" type="application/rss+xml">` and similar) and common paths such as `/feed` or `/rss.xml`. Duplicates are removed automatically.

maxItemsPerFeed.title: Max items per feed
maxItemsPerFeed.description: Deliver at most this many items from each feed (newest first, in feed order).

publishedAfter.title: Published after
publishedAfter.description: Optional. Skip items published before this date. ISO 8601, e.g. `2026-01-31` or `2026-01-31T12:00:00Z`. Items without a publication date are kept.

includeContent.title: Include full HTML content
includeContent.description: Add the article body as HTML (`contentHtml`, capped at 50,000 characters). Switch off for a smaller dataset when you only need titles and links.

plainText.title: Add plain-text content
plainText.description: Strip HTML from the article body into `contentText` (capped at 5,000 characters). Handy for search indexes, LLM prompts and spreadsheets.

onlyNew.title: Only new items since the last run
onlyNew.description: Monitor mode. The ids of every item delivered are remembered in a named key-value store, so scheduled runs return only items not seen before. The first run returns everything; later runs return only new posts. Items filtered out as already seen are never billed. Every record also carries an `isNew` flag, whether or not this is on.

timeoutSecs.title: Request timeout (seconds)
timeoutSecs.description: Give up on a feed after this many seconds.

stateStoreName.title: State store name
stateStoreName.description: Name of the key-value store that remembers seen item ids for **Only new items since the last run**. Leave empty for the automatic name `rss-feed-to-json-seen`. Use different names to keep separate watchlists (e.g. one per group of feeds). Letters, digits and dashes only.

seenTtlDays.title: Forget seen items after (days)
seenTtlDays.description: Ids not seen in any run for this many days are dropped from the state store, which keeps it small. An item that reappears after that is reported as new again. Use 0 to keep ids forever (up to 100,000 ids, oldest dropped first).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Route requests through Apify Proxy if a site blocks cloud IP addresses. Proxy usage is billed by Apify separately from the per-item price of this Actor.
